Delhi.

At Present In Central Jail Jaipur.
 ----Applicant
 Versus
The State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
 ----Respondent
For Applicant(s) : Mr. Dharmendra Choudhary For Respondent(s) : Ms. Arti Sharma, Pp Mr. Rhishi
Raj Singh Rathore, Pp Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sameer Jain Order 03/12/2025
1.
The instant bail application has been filed under Section 483 BNSS on behalf of accused-applicant.

The accused-applicant was arrested in connection with FIR No. 0422/2021 registered at Police Station Shyam Nagar District Jaipur City (South) for the offence(s) under Sections 420, 406 & 120-B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Shyam Nagar District Jaipur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that the applicant is elderly lady, aged about 70 years, suffering from feeble eyesight.
It is submitted that the co-accused has already been granted bail.
It is further submitted that the alleged offence is triable by the Magistrate and that there are no criminal antecedents registered against the applicant.
3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the instant bail application.
(Uploaded on 06/12/2025 at 03:18:08 PM)

4. Having heard the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and taking note of the fact that the applicant is senior citizen female, aged about 70 years; that there are no criminal antecedents registered against the applicant; that the co-accused in the instant matter has already been released on bail; that the matter at hand is triable by the Magistrate, and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and material on record but without commenting on merits/demerits of the case, this court is inclined to allow the instant bail application of the accused-applicant and enlarge her on bail.
5.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 483 BNSS is allowed and it is ordered that accused-applicant Kamlesh W/o Omprakash shall be enlarged on bail provided she furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned Kamlesh W/O Omprakash vs The State Of Rajasthan ... on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170177168/
